text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
WHEAT SALE - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd jointly bought 21,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp. company officials said.
- USDA said that private exporters reported sales of 100,000 tonnes of soft red winter wheat to unknown destinations for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year.

WHEAT SALE - The CCC said it bought 5,080 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Kenya. Shipment was slated for July 1-25. The wheat was bought from Cargill Inc at $147.44 a tonne, FOB, Houston, Texas.

SOYOIL SALE - China has purchased 28,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil for July shipment, U.S. exporters said. "They're (China) continuously buying at the moment but most of it comes from South America, said one soyoil trader. "This was a special case." Current prices in Brazil and Argentina are still more attractive to importers than those in the U.S., exporters said. The sale took place two or three days ago.

CORN TENDER - A South Korean buyers group, known as the Big Feed Mills, passed on a tender to buy up to 52,500 tonnes of corn because of higher-than-expected prices, officialsof the buyers group said on Wednesday.

CORN AND SOY TENDER - Malaysia's Soon Soon Oilmills Sdn Bhd is expected to tender on Wednesday for a combined cargo of corn and soybeans totalling 55,000 tonnes, traders said. The consignment is for October shipment and November arrival.
WHEAT TENDERS - Algeria has tendered to buy 150,000 tonnes of optional origin soft wheat for July and August shipment.

- WHEAT TENDERS (cont.) - Morocco has launched a tender for the purchase of 50,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat, European grain exporters said. Morocco is seeking the wheat in two shipments of 25,000 tonnes each, they said. Details of a shipment date were not immediately available.

- The CCC was tendering on June 19 for up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Armenia. The wheat was slated for June 30-July 15 shipment. The tender was in combination with another for 1,500 to 2,000 tonnes of U.S. HRW under PL-480 program, Title One. Shipment on the second tender was June 30-July 15 with offers due on June 19.

WHEAT TENDERS cont'd - Guyana was tendering on Thursday for 2,300 tonnes of spring wheat, 1,000 tonnes of soft red winter and 3,000 tonnes of hard red winter under the PL-480 program, agents for the buyer said. Shipment was slated for July 4-26.

- The CCC said it was seeking up to 6,750 tonnes of Northern Spring/Dark Northern Spring wheat for export to Honduras. The shipment period was set for July 10-August 5. The CCC said offers were due June 24.

WHEAT TENDERS - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders for the supply of 12,000 tonnes of soft bread making wheat, a statement from the commission said. Shipment period is scheduled between July 15 and 30, 1997. The tender closing date is Tuesday, June 24.

PALM OIL TENDER - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries said on Tuesday it was seeking 25,000 tonnes of Malaysian and/or Indonesian palm stearin and palm oil for delivery in August. Moharram Ghanem, head of the sales sector, told Reuters the deadline for bids was 0900 GMT on June 25. He said he wanted the oils in the following lots: -- 10,000 tonnes of palm stearin and 15,000 tonnes of palm oil.

MARKET TALK - China has been buying soybeans and soybean meal on recent price dips, picking up about half a million tonnes of beans and up to 350,000 tonnes of soybean meal in the past month, Far East traders said.
